## Description

Patient app (indigo): mobile number + SMS code (iOS one-time-code autofill, Android SMS Retriever), then biometric or PIN; 'who is this for' with family profiles and proxy access that is explicit, time-limited and visible; home with next visit, to-do list and emergency line; book (doctor, visit type, date, time, fee line), confirmation with add-to-calendar, check-in and reschedule; last copy offline, bookings queued. Same booking service and no-double-booking rule as reception.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a patient books from the app, when a reception booking takes the same slot, then only one succeeds and the other sees the next free slots.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a family member is viewed, when the proxy has expired, then access ends and the patient sees why.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the phone is offline, when the patient books, then the booking is queued and shown as not yet confirmed.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the SMS code arrives, when the patient opens the app, then the code is filled in automatically on iOS and Android.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
